newsitem.title: USA: Semiconductor Packaging sees lower Q4 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Semiconductor Packaging sees lower Q4 EPS.

text.p: Semiconductor Packaging Materials Co said on Monday it expects to report fourth-quarter results below analysts' estimates and below last year's fourth quarter, during which the company earned 12 cents a share.

The company cited weakness at several of its operations, including fewer orders for 8-inch silicon wafers made at its American Silicon Products Inc unit in Providence, Rhode Island, as reasons for the shortfall.
The company, which reports earnings at the end of January, said it expects revenues and earnings to begin to improve in the first quarter of 1997.
